newsitem.title: UK: OUTLOOK - Platinum group metals continue surge.
newsitem.headline: OUTLOOK - Platinum group metals continue surge.

text.p: LONDON - Platinum prices spiralled on Friday to the highest since 1990s, up some $50 from Thursday's London close. London market makers in palladium, which has been even more volatile, and its sister rare white metal platinum, said late Wednesday they would try to promote an orderly market. But, while denying rumours of any default on delivery, they added that the end of an acute shortage of the metals depends on Russia resuming delayed exports.
